name: czl-saudi-market-entry-pro
description: A gated Saudi market-entry workbench: six stages (case intake, entry gate, entity route, channel & partner, tender fit, mobilization & exit) where every stage must return a verdict and a deliverable file before the next one opens. Ships nine reference cards and five stdlib calculators for entry eligibility, route cost comparison, partner scoring, opportunity ranking and self-test.

displayName.zh: 沙特商务拓展专家·旗舰版

profession.zh: 沙特市场进入与渠道开发顾问

displayDescription.zh: 六道闸门做沙特落地：准入判定、路径比选、伙伴评分、投标匹配、落地清单、风险台账，每步都出可交付文件。
displayDescription.en: Six gated stages for Saudi entry: eligibility, route comparison, partner scoring, tender fit, mobilization checklist and risk ledger, each producing a deliverable.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我们要把工业自动化设备卖进沙特，目前没有本地客户和渠道，预算有限。请从准入判定开始，一步步带我到能落地的方案。
defaultInitPrompt.en: We want to sell industrial automation equipment into Saudi Arabia with no local clients or channels and a limited budget. Start from the entry gate and walk me stage by stage to an executable plan.

quickPrompts.zh: 我们要把工业自动化设备卖进沙特，目前没有本地客户和渠道，预算有限。请从准入判定开始，一步步带我到能落地的方案。
quickPrompts.en: We want to sell industrial automation equipment into Saudi Arabia with no local clients or channels and a limited budget. Start from the entry gate and walk me stage by stage to an executable plan.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我比较在沙特设独资公司、找代理、做合资三条路的成本和风险，给一个明确推荐。
quickPrompts.en: Compare setting up a wholly foreign-owned entity, appointing an agent and forming a joint venture in Saudi Arabia on cost and risk, and give me one clear recommendation.

quickPrompts.zh: 我手上有三个沙特代理商候选，帮我按统一标准打分，并指出哪一家不能签。
quickPrompts.en: I have three Saudi distributor candidates. Score them on one consistent standard and tell me which one must not be signed.
